messages:
Rae (People Ops): quick change: due to an HR export deadline were shifting the NA final lock to 03/30 23:59 PT (one day earlier). EMEA stays 04/02 23:59 CET. posting updated tracker now.
Nate (Eng Manager): ack. can managers still delegate their calibration slot if theyre out on the 30th?
Rae (People Ops): yes, delegation allowed. delegate must accept the invite and we need the delegate listed in the tracker. also include the word DELEGATE in the manager note when filing exceptions.
Priya (EM Manager): that earlier NA lock is tight for cross-region teams. will reminders be suppressed for EMEA folks who rely on the later window?
forms-bot: Reminder: region-specific reminders will be suppressed for users who opt into the EMEA window. System submissions respect account timezone where available but NA lock is enforced at 03/30 23:59 PT.
Jules (Manager): ok re: evidence uploads : whats the canonical fallback for big files if forms time out?
Rae (People Ops): fallback: upload to internal drive and paste link in reviewer comments OR email people-ops@redwood with subject "REVIEW-EVIDENCE + <employee>". include manager note and file description. we'll ingest manually.
Nate (Eng Manager): about late exceptions : can delegates approve on behalf of the primary manager?
Rae (People Ops): delegates can approve exceptions and issue approval codes. we'll log approver name and delegate status. if policy requires the primary manager, People Ops will flag during QA.
Priya (EM Manager): timebox per case? last cycle some sessions ran long and folks missed shifts.
Rae (People Ops): please use 3-5 minutes per case; adding explicit timebox to invites and the public schedule now.
Jules (Manager): will the rubric walkthrough still happen after the NA earlier lock? some new managers planned to attend after NA lock.
Rae (People Ops): walkthrough remains Wed 10:00 PT and will be recorded. well post slides and a 1-page cheat sheet in the tracker.
ops-bot: Banner posted in #general: "Calibration schedule updated: NA lock moved to Mar 30 23:59 PT. Expect limited review responses during calibration."
Rae (People Ops): final checklist for managers: 1) confirm delegate on invite if swapping 2) update tracker owner 3) ensure evidence link or email fallback ready 4) follow timeboxes. DM me for urgent approval codes. :white_check_mark:
